rules.title: Ashta Chamma Rules
rules.objective_content: Be the first player to move all 4 of your pawns from your home base to the center of the board.
rules.cowrie_content: Throw 4 cowrie shells to determine your move. The number of face-up shells determines your move distance.
rules.roll_0: 0 face-up = 8 (Ashta) — extra turn, can enter new pawn
rules.roll_1: 1 face-up = 1 — extra turn, can enter new pawn
rules.movement_content: Pawns move counterclockwise around the outer track, then up the inner home stretch. Landing on an opponent's pawn on a non-safe square captures it, sending it back to base.
rules.safe_squares_content: Marked squares are safe zones where pawns cannot be captured. Multiple pawns of different players may occupy safe squares simultaneously.
